release_notes: Maintenance release: the browser extension's overlay stats now apply the per-campaign Exclude Safe Page clicks filter in every query — the Ads Manager deep stats and the per-ad live aggregate — so the overlay finally agrees with the report opened next to it, and the safe-page predicate itself lives in one shared implementation instead of three hand-copied mirrors. On the report side the same checkbox is documented honestly: safe-page hits leave Visitors and everything derived from it (unique visitors, bots, empty referrers, cost, CPV) and were never part of Clicks, so Clicks, CPC and CR read the same either way. The Visitors column joined the default report preset so the effect is visible, and the cloak report test now asserts exact visitor numbers for both checkbox states.
